gaps: P0: none (only portrait woodcuts); P2: none; P5: none (the 1931 aerials are of Amboise, Blois and Orléans)
notes: #5 is the 1645 French edition of the 1572 plate. #14 was published 7 February 1863 and described as a view of about 1862. #24 (Bourgerie lithograph, Vue de Tours, printed by Clarey-Martineau) is probably about 1841 but its record gives no date; it would be a strong second P3. #11 (Rougeot, about 1785) is an alternative to #8. Not Tours: #12 Nantes, #13 Vannes, #15–16 Paris, #17 Villars-sur-Ollon, #18–20 Amboise, Blois, Orléans, #21 Tours-sur-Marne, #22 Montreal.
